77)"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"恐怖袭击事件"}]},{"type":"collapse_content","attrs":{"nodeId":"394e121d05e142ee86873cb810a0422c"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"e9423854-2900-4499-a75c-b0b3cfaf8968","nodeId":"1ee5042efa894d819e0f71212f4875ff"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"据中共巴楚县党委宣传部称，4月23日下午13时30分，3名社区工作人员走访镇内民居时，在一所居所内发现可疑刀具与人士，随后通过电话转报上级，其后被隐蔽室内的几名暴徒控制。当地派出所接获警报后，随同社区管理人员前往调查，赶赴现场时遭到居室内外的暴徒的袭杀，室内被控制的3名社区工作人员被杀害。赶来的众人遭到多名暴徒持1.2米长的刀具伏击，唯一携带手枪的派出所所长发射全部6颗子弹后仍然未能够突围，众人被逼进一间房间。暴徒随后堵死房门，灌入汽油，并且纵火将众人烧死。遇害者中包括蒙古族的色力布亚镇副镇长孙超。最后继续施暴的暴徒被警察击毙，合共6人，其余8人被逮捕。事件造成15位社区工作人员和警察殉职（其中维吾尔族10人、汉族3人、蒙古族2人）、2人受伤（均为维吾尔族），共21人死亡。烧毁房屋11间。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"6cecbc23-4d7d-41a6-bc1f-9b704db6ce7e","nodeId":"70b99c7e59c6429bb9e516f39f421cb9"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"4月29日天山网公布的细节称，木沙·艾山、艾尼瓦尔·阿布都热依木、买买提明·巴拉提、买买提明·马合木提、艾比布拉·巴拉提等人自2012年9月以来开始参加喀斯木·买买提组织的地下讲经班，观看宗教极端和暴恐内容的音视频，形成了以喀斯木·买买提为头目的团伙。当年12月初，喀斯木·买买提带领众人及家人集中至巴楚县色力布亚镇分散租住，并与大家在家中进行体能训练，模仿视频练习杀人技巧。2013年3月初，喀斯木·买买提与众人筹备活动经费，制造爆炸装置、头套、遥控器等，3月中旬，制造了8把大刀，先后进行5次试爆活动，并预谋这年夏天在喀什市人员密集的公共场所“干大事”。4月23日上午10时许，喀斯木·买买提命买买提明·马合木提、艾尼瓦尔·阿布都热依木在买买提明·巴拉提家制火药，自己与其他人在附近干活。13时许，买买提明·巴拉提、艾比布拉·巴拉提返回家时遇见社区工作人员和警察入户走访，艾比布拉·买买提借口取钥匙向喀斯木·买买提等人报信。喀斯木·买买提等5人随即乘坐摩托车赶回，将木沙·艾山出租房内的大刀等分发给大家，在买买提明·巴拉提家附近观察情况，当看到制爆物品被发现、制爆人员被控制后，喀斯木·买买提带领团伙成员冲进院内，与院内成员对在场社区干部及民警进行砍杀。镇派出所所长开枪击毙暴徒1名、击伤1名，3名社区女干部被杀害，其余9人被逼至房内，暴徒向屋内泼洒汽油并纵火，致全部遇难。后赶来的乡镇干部及民警相继遭伏击，民警击毙暴徒1名，1名乡镇干部遇害，2名民警重伤不治身亡。此后，4名暴徒冲出巷道打砸烧毁车辆，在冲击镇政府时1人被击毙，另3人劫持一辆三轮摩托车转而冲向派出所，将派出所档案室和民警宿舍点火焚烧，被击毙。["}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"4db94930-2ffa-4997-b545-97224a631f8c","nodeId":"3c7d9084ef244f4c99bcce056c7e093b"}}]},{"type":"table_cell","attrs":{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[540],"textAlign":"","verticalAlign":"top","bgColor":"rgb(255, 77)"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"点击展开内容"}]},{"type":"collapse_content","attrs":{"nodeId":"017caa845c7e414a8caf370f6432ab5c"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"951f7499-61c4-4a4d-b787-3d3a726330e1","nodeId":"9ab4db35a43d497b84349aeac6b6bb72"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"2013年10月28日中午12点05分左右（北京时间），一辆吉普车在北京天安门广场前由东闯入长安街便道。路透社援引一名目击者的话说，这辆车拖着一个写着黑字的白色标语。在撞倒多名行人之后，又撞上了天安门城楼前金水桥的护栏，随即起火。事发后，警方迅速封锁了天安门广场，并对周边地区进行交通管制。中国官方也立即删除了互联网上有关这件事的非官方信息"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"fc606b2f-a8f0-40ef-a42b-f29837f78ab7","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-BBC_Panic-6","title":"[","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"692bc8d7f3de4c57b5c12aa4eee14e43"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"["}],"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。外流照片上可见在天安门前毛泽东画像的下方，一台吉普车正起火燃烧，同时冒出大量浓烟。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"4e91a473-53c7-4fc4-a27c-65521a752d02","nodeId":"bef744d54e854e64bec8605c00ece8b6"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"最初的报道指车内3人当场死亡"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"87707fe3-97cb-4fcc-8d95-214b45059e4c","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-BBCOct29-3","title":"[","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"2cba4bc7c709447d8330f50b6ab1f42a"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"["}],"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。另有38人在事件中受伤，其中有11人被送往医院救治，其中两名当时在广场上的游客伤重死亡"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"718e620b-6f88-478d-8119-b45ef9369ab8","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-xinhua-11","title":"[","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"16306ee64479454b945500d2d52f1a51"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"["}],"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。受伤的38人中包括3名菲律宾游客（2女1男）和1名日本男游客。至当地时间10月30日下午，伤者中有5人已进行了手术，12人在ICU病房治疗，其余21人则转为一般住院或留院观察。至31日14时，送医的42名伤患中（包括已经重伤死亡的两名）累计3人出院，8人在ICU病房，10人已达出院标准。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"f22056ae-fa67-4689-a7ae-888e4154d94f","nodeId":"5e872bce2b9c4949b2fbbec1e7b3e191"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"中国大陆警方随后发出通知，要求北京各大酒店搜寻两名来自中国新疆的可疑人物。通知中同时提到了一辆汽车和新疆的车牌"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"ba188ab2-3a25-4d16-b6c9-009dd322fe4d","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-BBCOct29-3","title":"[","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"f93e92637e554ad1a473d2cf7ce8e45f"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"["}],"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。警方还指示酒店要注意可疑的客人。警方还要求酒店报告所有自10月1日登记入住的客人，以及他们所驾驶的车辆。并表示此指示“为了防止犯罪嫌疑人及车辆犯下更多的罪行"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"f1ff2e0c-d2db-45fb-9556-4a2a4b25ef1b","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-TIMEOct-17","title":"","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"b55e2adf3f664199a1b05beb8588f275"},"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。犯罪嫌疑人被指有维吾尔族姓名，来自常有暴力事件发生的新疆地区"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"8dcbbe52-cd6e-4037-8c06-2b40874e516e","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-18","title":"","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"8d6d3e18264642d18de2ebd9a2795a7e"},"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。其中一名嫌犯疑来自鄯善县。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"c7255592-1549-45f1-9778-70a80ce28370","nodeId":"12b04dc721f1441597c690c86fea56ef"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"11月24日，路透社消息指一个自称是“突厥斯坦伊斯兰党”的恐怖组织团体承认发动了10月28日天安门袭击事件，他们在网络上发表了一份录音：“60年来，你们(中华人民共和国政府)欺骗了东突厥，如今，我们觉醒了。人民明白了谁才是他们真正的敌人，他们接受了教训，回到自己的宗教中。” 77)"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"恐怖袭击事件"}]},{"type":"collapse_content","attrs":{"nodeId":"d352d884c9fa47b7a6081830cf54866a"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"19cad46e-768a-48b7-8c78-c187bbba6a25","nodeId":"3f6429ca862f48a99dbd2ffe87f64e37"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"据中共巴楚县党委宣传部称，4月23日下午13时30分，3名社区工作人员走访镇内民居时，在一所居所内发现可疑刀具与人士，随后通过电话转报上级，其后被隐蔽室内的几名暴徒控制。当地派出所接获警报后，随同社区管理人员前往调查，赶赴现场时遭到居室内外的暴徒的袭杀，室内被控制的3名社区工作人员被杀害。赶来的众人遭到多名暴徒持1.2米长的刀具伏击，唯一携带手枪的派出所所长发射全部6颗子弹后仍然未能够突围，众人被逼进一间房间。暴徒随后堵死房门，灌入汽油，并且纵火将众人烧死。遇害者中包括蒙古族的色力布亚镇副镇长孙超。最后继续施暴的暴徒被警察击毙，合共6人，其余8人被逮捕。事件造成15位社区工作人员和警察殉职（其中维吾尔族10人、汉族3人、蒙古族2人）、2人受伤（均为维吾尔族），共21人死亡。烧毁房屋11间。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"f0149511-6824-4f66-be3e-0086775ea8f6","nodeId":"10e3dc5c0b984c73b62fc08821289ec4"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"4月29日天山网公布的细节称，木沙·艾山、艾尼瓦尔·阿布都热依木、买买提明·巴拉提、买买提明·马合木提、艾比布拉·巴拉提等人自2012年9月以来开始参加喀斯木·买买提组织的地下讲经班，观看宗教极端和暴恐内容的音视频，形成了以喀斯木·买买提为头目的团伙。当年12月初，喀斯木·买买提带领众人及家人集中至巴楚县色力布亚镇分散租住，并与大家在家中进行体能训练，模仿视频练习杀人技巧。2013年3月初，喀斯木·买买提与众人筹备活动经费，制造爆炸装置、头套、遥控器等，3月中旬，制造了8把大刀，先后进行5次试爆活动，并预谋这年夏天在喀什市人员密集的公共场所“干大事”。4月23日上午10时许，喀斯木·买买提命买买提明·马合木提、艾尼瓦尔·阿布都热依木在买买提明·巴拉提家制火药，自己与其他人在附近干活。13时许，买买提明·巴拉提、艾比布拉·巴拉提返回家时遇见社区工作人员和警察入户走访，艾比布拉·买买提借口取钥匙向喀斯木·买买提等人报信。喀斯木·买买提等5人随即乘坐摩托车赶回，将木沙·艾山出租房内的大刀等分发给大家，在买买提明·巴拉提家附近观察情况，当看到制爆物品被发现、制爆人员被控制后，喀斯木·买买提带领团伙成员冲进院内，与院内成员对在场社区干部及民警进行砍杀。镇派出所所长开枪击毙暴徒1名、击伤1名，3名社区女干部被杀害，其余9人被逼至房内，暴徒向屋内泼洒汽油并纵火，致全部遇难。后赶来的乡镇干部及民警相继遭伏击，民警击毙暴徒1名，1名乡镇干部遇害，2名民警重伤不治身亡。此后，4名暴徒冲出巷道打砸烧毁车辆，在冲击镇政府时1人被击毙，另3人劫持一辆三轮摩托车转而冲向派出所，将派出所档案室和民警宿舍点火焚烧，被击毙。["}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"830e8d67-be39-4310-9cc3-78076d4389d2","nodeId":"ef8cb19a8d3b4a5d9dd87c53451eaa39"}}]},{"type":"table_cell","attrs":{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[540],"textAlign":"","verticalAlign":"top","bgColor":"rgb(255, 77)"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"点击展开内容"}]},{"type":"collapse_content","attrs":{"nodeId":"e72787eedff14df3829ee124172c7fcb"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"6106cda5-0d69-4866-b072-be5c6a419293","nodeId":"1ffb858a1c3c4d2fb5e94922b0cbcf58"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"2013年10月28日中午12点05分左右（北京时间），一辆吉普车在北京天安门广场前由东闯入长安街便道。路透社援引一名目击者的话说，这辆车拖着一个写着黑字的白色标语。在撞倒多名行人之后，又撞上了天安门城楼前金水桥的护栏，随即起火。事发后，警方迅速封锁了天安门广场，并对周边地区进行交通管制。中国官方也立即删除了互联网上有关这件事的非官方信息"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"cd2e9951-39dd-4f0d-8a27-fc38c8fa8ca8","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-BBC_Panic-6","title":"[","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"516becc6ca6941caabd4992877c034d5"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"["}],"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。外流照片上可见在天安门前毛泽东画像的下方，一台吉普车正起火燃烧，同时冒出大量浓烟。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"26715c03-c6eb-4795-9b18-ec86d1162f6f","nodeId":"b65995c8857b4afb84841f5a399db1b0"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"最初的报道指车内3人当场死亡"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"f826e33a-e1a3-4e0f-806b-5b79f46de6cf","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-BBCOct29-3","title":"[","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"2c00713c4b28476d87e9f3a968da8182"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"["}],"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。另有38人在事件中受伤，其中有11人被送往医院救治，其中两名当时在广场上的游客伤重死亡"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"716034ba-9f9d-4d09-9324-7123349da443","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-xinhua-11","title":"[","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"fb306102420746c7b947e92a9bb6d0f7"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"["}],"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。受伤的38人中包括3名菲律宾游客（2女1男）和1名日本男游客。至当地时间10月30日下午，伤者中有5人已进行了手术，12人在ICU病房治疗，其余21人则转为一般住院或留院观察。至31日14时，送医的42名伤患中（包括已经重伤死亡的两名）累计3人出院，8人在ICU病房，10人已达出院标准。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"71133848-e22a-4937-ad3b-e6fde56cc8e3","nodeId":"50972517ab374f04a9954dc364c59003"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"中国大陆警方随后发出通知，要求北京各大酒店搜寻两名来自中国新疆的可疑人物。通知中同时提到了一辆汽车和新疆的车牌"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"f00d0125-a19e-41fd-bc65-b9d72ee3e430","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-BBCOct29-3","title":"[","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"53d046d578f24415ae442469f516d12c"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"["}],"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。警方还指示酒店要注意可疑的客人。警方还要求酒店报告所有自10月1日登记入住的客人，以及他们所驾驶的车辆。并表示此指示“为了防止犯罪嫌疑人及车辆犯下更多的罪行"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"7f4be15a-79e8-4807-af34-b1ae02e4303b","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4%E6%A1%A5%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E8%A2%AD%E5%87%BB%E6%A1%88#cite_note-TIMEOct-17","title":"","autoUpdate":false,"nodeId":"6b1ae64094614e8686b670f3924b9c8f"},"marks":[{"type":"sup"}]},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"。犯罪嫌疑人被指有维吾尔族姓名，来自常有暴力事件发生的新疆地区"},{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"3dbd4537-df3f-45a9-9a90-c4a1d0399364","href":"https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8%E9%87%91%E6%B0%B4% 128)"}},{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第六条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者不得制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的违法信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"b2b4e920-67dd-495b-90c8-b35dd1dd3b5c","nodeId":"54cad8b1dfe6481498acb15719794eb8"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(一)反对宪法所确定的基本原则的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"f08a58ba-18ad-4a7e-bca4-5c63bdc56a45","nodeId":"59dc4234439847da9ef42e4a26c1d1f4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(二)危害国家安全，泄露国家秘密，颠覆国家政权，破坏国家统一的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"be52b03a-7620-40ab-baad-20df8913d24c","nodeId":"3a2503ebf0d34e66930759a1560327d3"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(三)损害国家荣誉和利益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"d386a9b5-9173-4546-a4a3-0d1c7c8e76bf","nodeId":"f0490315006042cb8686921e8232d630"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(四)歪曲、丑化、亵渎、否定英雄烈士事迹和精神，以侮辱、诽谤或者其他方式侵害英雄烈士的姓名、肖像、名誉、荣誉的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"89e35be4-bbcb-4562-b462-4f3e6faad4b1","nodeId":"bcb631d9134843c899f09a4b1ac941f5"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"(五)宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义或者煽动实施恐怖活动、极端主义活动的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"632092c1-dfc3-423e-a4e2-446ac3610db8","nodeId":"7bb2fb2a21724fe88a711680127a23c4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(六)煽动民族仇恨、民族歧视，破坏民族团结的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"94dc9fbd-9f11-4ca8-993d-55f1b41f62f2","nodeId":"4c13713a033e445cab064d3663b40cdc"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(七)破坏国家宗教政策，宣扬邪教和封建迷信的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"12c4fd09-f010-4368-8767-52722e9241fc","nodeId":"a22b5e6f55e74ce3999e5dd91d9aafe2"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(八)散布谣言，扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"ebf8a5b1-e70f-427a-b71a-14c178bae6b2","nodeId":"0db2385a3be8469cb2c3cf1a4a4ead31"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(九)散布淫秽、色情、赌博、暴力、凶杀、恐怖或者教唆犯罪的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"43507f70-a764-40dd-b449-bee1a1b076e7","nodeId":"f1ccbf611d1446d6ad139883bc32bae4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(十)侮辱或者诽谤他人，侵害他人名誉、隐私和其他合法权益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"9c254cb8-2026-45a0-9221-fef032f0eb0d","nodeId":"f1a96e57180449c6a99fd12c5645476a"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"　　(十一)法律、行政法规禁止的其他内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"22e3346e-a5dc-4090-bc3d-42b61bdfdff1","nodeId":"b4b307be89da48dfb4e0d2f380a6f1f9"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"网络信息内容生态治理规定"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"ffd7a440-f57a-4edf-90f5-ab3833cbdb54","nodeId":"b966295258664cb0981f604ed656b390"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第六条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者不得制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的违法信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"39f9964d-de9a-4ef8-8bdb-d1d370aeda96","nodeId":"83556c89badc4604be1ccc811f345511"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）反对宪法所确定的基本原则的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"d8fe5a08-dec4-4bf2-8d2e-198011cffc60","nodeId":"78289401415641738ec2350e369be613"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（二）危害国家安全，泄露国家秘密，颠覆国家政权，破坏国家统一的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"7d144bb6-ae93-448d-a13b-d737b9ee784b","nodeId":"aefd3a4ae4ce40999d23c0549c73ff2c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）损害国家荣誉和利益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"87cae15b-1b3d-4523-ab22-2e3210f65caf","nodeId":"3dfb1e748f2d4cf7a3414f8e1d0f13b4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）歪曲、丑化、亵渎、否定英雄烈士事迹和精神，以侮辱、诽谤或者其他方式侵害英雄烈士的姓名、肖像、名誉、荣誉的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"cdd13f2a-8bd0-472f-9559-9a8fd8c39ad6","nodeId":"4bb8e745852e425fb54378d25121ca9b"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（五）宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义或者煽动实施恐怖活动、极端主义活动的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"2f2b07d9-87ad-4cf5-a9f3-736885bb27c2","nodeId":"deaaa30e2c4946d4803f096aeb9860f0"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）煽动民族仇恨、民族歧视，破坏民族团结的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6bda35c4-ea2b-4210-9f2d-127e25a850cb","nodeId":"7bccd5a7ab854b85bae78027cc181c24"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）破坏国家宗教政策，宣扬邪教和封建迷信的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"3b04b45c-8c68-4f4b-93cf-c05c41327ead","nodeId":"fdbcd3216a7340c7a10f9230eefa3a0e"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）散布谣言，扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"25aa4295-99c4-4a71-b996-cb7daf34a544","nodeId":"f531c9a0879e4d4a9d3ca4dfbb8f1c94"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）散布淫秽、色情、赌博、暴力、凶杀、恐怖或者教唆犯罪的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a0361954-a45c-46da-979a-acdae665c53d","nodeId":"a5a26d66748d453998b506f93915d5f1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十）侮辱或者诽谤他人，侵害他人名誉、隐私和其他合法权益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"56d14ba4-3e95-41df-896b-9cde1e4bd3e3","nodeId":"20b4b210431f4a2fbe4fc3a6da8d4946"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十一）法律、行政法规禁止的其他内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"2fec5338-a853-4c26-8a94-a30a4eacf629","nodeId":"481339fd9b07465f8930f3be6b47fa08"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第七条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者应当采取措施，防范和抵制制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的不良信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"c931890c-e716-41e9-8674-93f034d4c8b7","nodeId":"99a7aedad215479d9a9ee6697595a628"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）使用夸张标题，内容与标题严重不符的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"7f7986b1-c128-46a2-b49b-830a890d47e3","nodeId":"7ca76aef73e6457eaeee0d2c5f8bc230"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（二）炒作绯闻、丑闻、劣迹等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"e767eac6-1fe7-483c-8b02-3c4a0f766182","nodeId":"0742abab94b44938b96ee005b352d0f7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）不当评述自然灾害、重大事故等灾难的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b2117aa6-19f0-4f07-a543-6e18d7956767","nodeId":"3626da3887854b998cbc66035b130b00"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）带有性暗示、性挑逗等易使人产生性联想的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"c6ee68bd-1706-4455-82e7-4e58c24d14ae","nodeId":"8464b7f0bab04490b3b81537f8764a13"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）展现血腥、惊悚、残忍等致人身心不适的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b598f645-0a66-4fbf-9315-683b488d5bcf","nodeId":"11ccb24c3fcb48e3bf9022572a2b38be"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）煽动人群歧视、地域歧视等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"06dcae88-4305-4140-8012-1d25f5537645","nodeId":"4c87c205d0a5449c8168d3839ee595b7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）宣扬低俗、庸俗、媚俗内容的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"c517fcf7-b159-4bb4-9ac7-8f42c0b377d3","nodeId":"dbed36ecc3364772a29059b03afc36cd"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）可能引发未成年人模仿不安全行为和违反社会公德行为、诱导未成年人不良嗜好等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b4cc9a18-b7b8-45fe-8636-2596207e3630","nodeId":"92666dc3d8db44828643eae741eafe50"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）其他对网络生态造成不良影响的内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"e632d921-0b21-4bae-9b10-7f8ca22a41af","nodeId":"051b24f9b7154d4297748b666a403c91"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"86c79eb9-8b37-4810-8f64-4ff0b45d9ce8","nodeId":"767f8f5ba0fa4cf7abf0a1c584c020c9"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","data
